:::{#thm-bernoulli-loglik-one-group}
#### Log-likelihood of binary outcomes with one event probability

Let $Y_i \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $i = 1, \dots, n$, and $\vy \eqdef (\dsn{y})$.
The log-likelihood of $\vy$ is:

$$\llik(\prob; \vy) = \paren{\sumin y_i} \logit(\prob) + n \logf{1 - \prob}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-loglik-one-group.

:::
